title: Afuris Prime
extract:
Afuris Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Afuris akimbo pistols, acting as a direct upgrade. Afuris Prime was released alongside  Baruuk Prime and  Cobra & Crane Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)

Trivia
The Afuris Prime, alongside  Akbolto Prime,  Aksomati Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Dual Keres Prime,  Fang Prime,  Gunsen Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
The Afuris Prime and  Akbolto Prime are currently the only two Primed pistols whose normal variants have both single and dual variants, but only of which the dual variant is primed; no singular Furis Prime currently exists.
While all the other  Tenno and Prime akimbo pistols have prefix Ak-, prefix for akimbo Furis is only A-.
